verdict.rationale: Swell documents price rules for customer groups such as wholesale accounts, plus tiered price breaks. It also claims to run wholesale and retail from a single catalog and dashboard, which covers group pricing, volume pricing and selling alongside DTC. Nothing in the evidence covers quotes or net-terms invoicing, and support is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: quote/RFQ workflow, net-terms invoicing, per-customer (not just per-group) price lists, in-depth docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell B2B and wholesale — customer-specific price lists, volume pricing, quotes or net-terms invoicing — alongside DTC

citations.quote: Use price rules for specific customer groups like wholesale accounts/VIPs, and offer tiered-price breaks.
Run your wholesale and retail operations from a single catalog and dashboard.
